name: dep_graph
description: Import graph of the project (Py modules, Go packages, JS/TS files): nodes, edges, cycles, externals, most imported

path.description: directory or file to parse; ids stay relative to the project root (default: root). Test files, .git/node_modules/vendor/dist/testdata and files > 512 KB are skipped

lang.description: only this language (default auto: all three; js covers ts/tsx/mjs/cjs)

limit.description: edges to return, sorted by (from, to); counts and cycles use the whole graph (default 2000)

internal_only.description: true (default): only project modules as nodes; false: externals become nodes too (file empty)

nodes.id: str (py: dotted module, go: import path, js: file path)

data.text: N files, M edges, K cycles
